newsitem.title: UK: UK lines up Stagecoach for Island Line rail.
newsitem.headline: UK lines up Stagecoach for Island Line rail.

text.p: The director of the UK's Office of Passenger Rail Franchising (Opraf) said that he had picked Stagecoach Holdings Plc as preferred bidder for the Island Line Ltd franchise.
A formal award announcement with further details of the deal will be made soon, a statement from Opraf said.
The Island Line franchise runs trains in the Isle of Wight, off the southern coast of England.
Stagecoach is already Britain's biggest public transport group after expanding at top speed since its creation 16 years ago to take advantage of the UK government's sales of rail and bus networks.
Last week, Stagecoach moved to expand outside the UK with the purchase of Swebus, the leading bus operator in the Nordic region.
